name: devops-lsp
description: A DevOps marketplace of Claude Code language-server plugins. Add it once and use the same TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, Python, shell, and PHP support in every project.

plugins.name: typescript-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript and JavaScript code intelligence, plus auto-heal: eslint --fix after edits and a tsc --noEmit gate before a turn can end.

plugins.name: rust-lsp
plugins.description: Rust code intelligence, plus auto-heal: rustfmt after edits and a cargo clippy gate before a turn can end.

plugins.name: python-lsp
plugins.description: Python code intelligence, plus auto-heal: ruff check --fix and ruff format after edits and a basedpyright gate before a turn can end.

plugins.name: shell-lsp
plugins.description: Shell script code intelligence, plus auto-heal: shfmt after edits and a shellcheck gate before a turn can end.

plugins.name: php-lsp
plugins.description: PHP code intelligence, plus auto-heal: php -l and the project's formatter after edits and a PHPStan gate before a turn can end.
